name: Alter Scent
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 0, sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 action
Components V, S, F (handkerchief or letter scented in perfume)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target object touched or any one creature
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The target’s scent is changed to any other of the caster’s choice. The scent lasts for the duration of the spell and can be removed only with a successful dispel magic. The scent can be anything that the caster wishes, either pleasant or offensive. This effectively gives a –1 or +1 enhancement modifier to the target’s Charisma score. A creature whose scent is changed by this spell is harder to track with the Scent ability, adding +5 to the tracking DC.
